US.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and miscellaneous personal expenses.

IN.description: Includes groceries, local transportation, utilities, and modest entertainment. Can vary significantly by city and lifestyle.

SG.description: Singapore has a high cost of living, particularly for groceries, transport, and dining, but public transport is efficient and affordable.

CH.description: Cost of living is exceptionally high for groceries, transportation, dining out, and general services.

NL.description: Cost of living is high for groceries, transportation, and utilities, while dining out can vary.

GB.description: Average monthly expenses for groceries, utilities, local transport, and personal leisure for a single person.

CA.description: Cost of living is relatively high, especially for groceries, dining, and personal care. Public transportation is developed but not inexpensive; utilities are moderate.

AE.description: High cost for dining out and imported goods, but utilities and transportation are moderate. Groceries can vary.

NO.description: Very high costs for groceries, public transport, and dining out. Utilities and internet are moderately high.

IE.description: Covers groceries, transport, utilities, and personal expenses.

LU.description: Cost of living is generally very high, with groceries, transportation, and dining out being particularly expensive.

AU.description: Generally high for groceries, utilities, and transport. Public healthcare is subsidized.

QA.description: The cost of living, excluding rent, is moderately high for groceries, transportation, and daily expenses, but generally lower than many major Western cities.

BN.description: The cost of living excluding rent in Brunei Darussalam is moderate, covering expenses for groceries, transportation, utilities, and daily necessities.

MO.description: Cost of living is high, particularly for groceries, dining out, and imported goods, while public transportation is relatively affordable.
